question: How does Estonia support single-parent families?

context_chunks.text: Since January 2022, the Ministry of Social Affairs has been looking for solutions to support single-parent families. The support needs of single parents are much wider than just financial support. There is a chronic lack of time, lack of flexible childcare, and high expectation of better access to hobby education.

expected_answer: Estonia is working to improve support for single-parent families. Since January 2022, the Ministry of Social Affairs has been developing comprehensive solutions. They've identified that single parents need more than just financial support - they also need flexible childcare options, better access to hobby education for children, and relationship counseling. The ministry is planning pilot projects to address these needs.
